updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coinbase推出了一个允许AI代理自主买卖和支付加密货币的平台，消息公布后COIN股价上涨超过3%。 这标志着向‘代理金融’（agentic finance）迈出了切实一步，自主AI系统将加密货币作为其金融后端。同时，这也让Coinbase占据了AI与加密的交汇点，可能从机器对机器支付中开辟新的收入来源。 据Decrypt报道，Coinbase的新工具是一个MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，允许AI代理持有钱包并发送稳定币支付，它建立在Coinbase用于机器对机器转账的x402协议之上。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase introduced a payments platform that lets AI agents autonomously buy, sell, and pay using cryptocurrency, and COIN stock gained over 3% on the news. This marks a concrete step toward 'agentic finance,' where autonomous AI systems use crypto as their financial backend. It also positions Coinbase at the intersection of AI and crypto, potentially opening new revenue streams from machine-to-machine payments. According to Decrypt, Coinbase's new tool is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that allows AI agents to hold wallets and send stablecoin payments, and it builds on Coinbase's x402 protocol for machine-to-machine transfers.
